title: Could Ukraine's drone strikes mark a turning point in war with Russia?
summary: PRESS REVIEW – Monday, May 18, 2026: First, Ukraine's drone attacks on Russia may mark a turning point in the war. Next, Venezuela's post-Maduro era is conflicting for locals.
